data.gender_notes: Henrion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Henricus', meaning 'strong ruler, powerful one'. Named after Henry, a Germanic name meaning 'home ruler'. The name Henrion signifies strength, power, and leadership. In Christian tradition, it is associated with St. Henry, a holy Roman Emperor and patron saint of Europe. The name Henrion carries the meaning “Strong mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Henrion usually hope their child will grow to embody strong mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Henrion total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Individuals named Henrion were traditionally seen as natural-born leaders, strong in character and capable of guiding others. data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Henrion holds a deep spiritual significance, being derived from St. Henry, the name's patron saint. St. Henry (912-936 AD) was a German-Roman emperor known for his devotion and piety. He played a pivotal role in strengthening the Church's position in the empire, championed the cause of the poor and was known for his just rule. Thus, the name Henrion symbolizes the spiritual qualities of strength, integrity, and true leadership rooted in kindness and compassion.
